name: Barrel Boat Adventure

start.dialog: Barrel life on LAND is good! But what about WATER? I built a barrel RAFT! Need someone to test it! Through the Mire canals! Dangerous? Maybe! Fun? DEFINITELY!
start.objective: Test the barrel raft by navigating through the Mire canals

progress.dialog: How's the raft? Seaworthy? Barrel-worthy? I'm getting reports!
progress.objective: Continue the barrel raft journey through the canals

complete.dialog: You SURVIVED! The barrel raft is a SUCCESS! I'm a GENIUS! Here - waterproof barrel! For your belongings! Keeps stuff DRY! Revolutionary!

party_comments.kade: Riding a barrel through swamp canals. Sure. Why not.
party_comments.twist: Wheeeee! This is better than a real boat!
party_comments.nix7: Buoyancy calculation: questionable. Entertainment value: high.

hidden_outcome: If you complete the route without tipping over, Barrelman declares you 'Barrel Admiral' and gives you a map to a hidden underwater treasure
